<IfModule mod_headers.c>
    # Le regex accepte : https://much.ma, https://www.much.ma, http://localhost, http://localhost:3000, http://127.0.0.1:8080, etc.
    SetEnvIf Origin "^(https?://(?:www\.)?much\.ma|https?://(?:localhost|127\.0\.0\.1)(?::\d+)?)$" ACCESS_CONTROL_ALLOW_ORIGIN=$1
    
    Header always set Access-Control-Allow-Origin "%{ACCESS_CONTROL_ALLOW_ORIGIN}e" env=ACCESS_CONTROL_ALLOW_ORIGIN
    Header always set Access-Control-Allow-Methods "GET, POST, OPTIONS" env=ACCESS_CONTROL_ALLOW_ORIGIN
    Header always set Access-Control-Allow-Headers "Content-Type, Authorization, X-WP-Nonce, Accept, X-Requested-With, woocommerce-session" env=ACCESS_CONTROL_ALLOW_ORIGIN
    Header always set Access-Control-Allow-Credentials "true" env=ACCESS_CONTROL_ALLOW_ORIGIN
</IfModule>

</IfModule>

</IfModule>

# =================================================================
# 1. CONFIGURATION CORS DYNAMIQUE (Gère www et non-www)
# =================================================================
<IfModule mod_headers.c>
    # Capture l'origine exacte (https://much.ma OU https://www.much.ma)
    SetEnvIf Origin "^(https://(?:www\.)?much\.ma)$" ACCESS_CONTROL_ALLOW_ORIGIN=$1
    
    # Applique les en-têtes uniquement si l'origine correspond exactement
    Header always set Access-Control-Allow-Origin "%{ACCESS_CONTROL_ALLOW_ORIGIN}e" env=ACCESS_CONTROL_ALLOW_ORIGIN
    Header always set Access-Control-Allow-Methods "GET, POST, OPTIONS" env=ACCESS_CONTROL_ALLOW_ORIGIN
    # J'ai ajouté 'woocommerce-session' car il apparaît dans vos en-têtes
    Header always set Access-Control-Allow-Headers "Content-Type, Authorization, X-WP-Nonce, Accept, X-Requested-With, woocommerce-session" env=ACCESS_CONTROL_ALLOW_ORIGIN
    Header always set Access-Control-Allow-Credentials "true" env=ACCESS_CONTROL_ALLOW_ORIGIN
</IfModule>

# =================================================================
# 2. GESTION DES REQUÊTES PREFLIGHT (OPTIONS)
# =================================================================
<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
    RewriteEngine On
    # Répondre immédiatement 200 OK aux requêtes OPTIONS
    RewriteCond %{REQUEST_METHOD} OPTIONS
    RewriteRule ^(.*)$ - [R=200,L]
</IfModule>

# =================================================================
# 3. RÈGLES STANDARDS WORDPRESS
# =================================================================
# BEGIN WordPress

RewriteEngine On
RewriteRule .* - [E=HTTP_AUTHORIZATION:%{HTTP:Authorization}]
RewriteBase /
RewriteRule ^index\.php$ - [L]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
RewriteRule . /index.php [L]
</IfModule>
# END WordPress

plugin envoi de commande a ga

/**
 * Plugin Name: Doshift – Orders → External API
 * Description: Envoi des commandes WooCommerce vers une API externe (DoShift/Directus) avec auto-envoi par statut + bouton "DoShift : Renvoyer vers API" + villes (ozon_id/cathedis_id) + supplier_code par item + woo_user + woo_user_name + woo_source.
 * Author: DoShift
 * Version: 1.3.1-doshift
 */

if (!defined('ABSPATH')) exit;

define('DOSHIFT_ORDERS_API_VERSION', '1.3.1-doshift');
define('DOSHIFT_ORDERS_API_OPTION',  'doshift_orders_api_settings');

/* =========================================================
 * Helpers settings
 * ======================================================= */

/**
 * Valeurs par défaut.
 */
function doshift_orders_api_default_settings() {
    return [
        'api_url'                 => 'https://ga.milaffat.ma/items/orders',
        'api_token'               => 'N0mNq_nc64YLqZA788BIA3dYk4VJ6n9V',

        // Statut Woo qui déclenche l’envoi automatique (ex: processing, confirmed…)
        'auto_send_status'        => 'processing',
        // 2ème statut déclencheur (optionnel)
        'auto_send_status_2'      => '',

        // Statut Woo après succès (ex: completed, confirmed…)
        'success_next_status'     => 'completed',
        // 2ème statut cible après succès (lié au 2ème déclencheur)
        'success_next_status_2'   => '',

        // Valeur pour "status" dans le JSON envoyé à l’API (1er déclencheur)
        'status_to_send'          => 'ENCOURS',
        // Valeur pour "status" dans le JSON envoyé à l’API (2ème déclencheur)
        'status_to_send_2'        => 'ENCOURS',

        // Metas pour les villes (plugin "Doshift — Villes")
        'ozon_city_id_meta'       => 'ozon_id',
        'ozon_city_name_meta'     => 'city_name_fr',
        'cathedis_city_id_meta'   => 'cathedis_id',
        'cathedis_city_name_meta' => 'city_name_fr',

        // Code ville que tu veux envoyer (par défaut = ozon_id)
        'billing_city_code_meta'  => 'ozon_id',
    ];
}

/**
 * Retourne les settings fusionnés avec les defaults.
 */
function doshift_orders_api_get_settings() {
    $saved = get_option(DOSHIFT_ORDERS_API_OPTION, []);
    if (!is_array($saved)) $saved = [];
    return wp_parse_args($saved, doshift_orders_api_default_settings());
}

/* =========================================================
 * Admin : menu & page de configuration
 * ======================================================= */

add_action('admin_menu', function () {
    if (!class_exists('WooCommerce')) return;

    add_submenu_page(
        'woocommerce',
        'DoShift – Orders API',
        'DoShift – Orders API',
        'manage_woocommerce',
        'doshift-orders-api',
        'doshift_orders_api_settings_page'
    );
});

/**
 * Page d'options simple.
 */
function doshift_orders_api_settings_page() {
    if (!current_user_can('manage_woocommerce')) {
        wp_die(__('Vous n’avez pas les droits.', 'woocommerce'));
    }

    $settings = doshift_orders_api_get_settings();

    if (isset($_POST['doshift_orders_api_save'])) {
        check_admin_referer('doshift_orders_api_save');

        $fields = [
            'api_url',
            'api_token',
            'auto_send_status',
            'auto_send_status_2',
            'success_next_status',
            'success_next_status_2',
            'status_to_send',
            'status_to_send_2',
            'ozon_city_id_meta',
            'ozon_city_name_meta',
            'cathedis_city_id_meta',
            'cathedis_city_name_meta',
            'billing_city_code_meta',
        ];

        foreach ($fields as $f) {
            $settings[$f] = isset($_POST[$f]) ? sanitize_text_field(wp_unslash($_POST[$f])) : '';
        }

        update_option(DOSHIFT_ORDERS_API_OPTION, $settings);
        echo '<div class="updated"><p>Paramètres enregistrés.</p></div>';
    }

    $statuses = function_exists('wc_get_order_statuses') ? wc_get_order_statuses() : [];

    ?>
    <div class="wrap">
        <h1>DoShift – Orders → External API</h1>
        <p>Configuration de l’envoi des commandes WooCommerce vers l’API Directus / DoShift.</p>

        <form method="post">
            <?php wp_nonce_field('doshift_orders_api_save'); ?>

            <h2>1. API</h2>
            <table class="form-table">
                <tr>
                    <th scope="row"><label for="api_url">API URL</label></th>
                    <td>
                        <input name="api_url" id="api_url" type="text" class="regular-text" value="<?php echo esc_attr($settings['api_url']); ?>">
                        <p class="description">Exemple : <code>https://ga.milaffat.ma/items/orders</code></p>
                    </td>
                </tr>
                <tr>
                    <th scope="row"><label for="api_token">API Token (Bearer)</label></th>
                    <td>
                        <input name="api_token" id="api_token" type="text" class="regular-text" value="<?php echo esc_attr($settings['api_token']); ?>">
                    </td>
                </tr>
            </table>

            <h2>2. Statuts WooCommerce</h2>
            <table class="form-table">
                <tr>
                    <th scope="row"><label for="auto_send_status">Statut déclencheur d’envoi automatique (1)</label></th>
                    <td>
                        <select name="auto_send_status" id="auto_send_status">
                            <option value="">— Désactivé —</option>
                            <?php foreach ($statuses as $key => $label):
                                $clean = preg_replace('/^wc-/', '', $key); ?>
                                <option value="<?php echo esc_attr($clean); ?>" <?php selected($clean, $settings['auto_send_status']); ?>>
                                    <?php echo esc_html($label) . ' (' . esc_html($clean) . ')'; ?>
                                </option>
                            <?php endforeach; ?>
                        </select>
                    </td>
                </tr>

                <tr>
                    <th scope="row"><label for="success_next_status">Statut Woo après succès d’envoi (1)</label></th>
                    <td>
                        <select name="success_next_status" id="success_next_status">
                            <option value="">— Ne pas changer —</option>
                            <?php foreach ($statuses as $key => $label):
                                $clean = preg_replace('/^wc-/', '', $key); ?>
                                <option value="<?php echo esc_attr($clean); ?>" <?php selected($clean, $settings['success_next_status']); ?>>
                                    <?php echo esc_html($label) . ' (' . esc_html($clean) . ')'; ?>
                                </option>
                            <?php endforeach; ?>
                        </select>
                    </td>
                </tr>

                <tr>
                    <th scope="row"><label for="auto_send_status_2">Statut déclencheur d’envoi automatique (2)</label></th>
                    <td>
                        <select name="auto_send_status_2" id="auto_send_status_2">
                            <option value="">— Désactivé —</option>
                            <?php foreach ($statuses as $key => $label):
                                $clean = preg_replace('/^wc-/', '', $key); ?>
                                <option value="<?php echo esc_attr($clean); ?>" <?php selected($clean, $settings['auto_send_status_2']); ?>>
                                    <?php echo esc_html($label) . ' (' . esc_html($clean) . ')'; ?>
                                </option>
                            <?php endforeach; ?>
                        </select>
                    </td>

                <tr>
                    <th scope="row"><label for="success_next_status_2">Statut Woo après succès d’envoi (2)</label></th>
                    <td>
                        <select name="success_next_status_2" id="success_next_status_2">
                            <option value="">— Ne pas changer —</option>

/* =========================================================
 * Helper supplier_code
 * ======================================================= */

/**
 * Récupère supplier_code pour une ligne :
 * priorité snapshot -> produit
 */
function doshift_get_supplier_code_from_order_item($item) {
    $supplier = (string) $item->get_meta('_supplier_code_snapshot', true);
    if ($supplier === '') {
        $product = $item->get_product();
        if ($product) {
            $supplier = (string) $product->get_meta('_supplier_code', true);
        }
    }
    return $supplier;
}

/* =========================================================
 * Helpers source + user créateur
 * ======================================================= */

/**
 * Détecte si la commande a été créée manuellement depuis l'admin WooCommerce.
 */
function doshift_order_is_manual_admin_order($order) {
    if (!$order) return false;

    $created_via = '';
    if (is_callable([$order, 'get_created_via'])) {
        $created_via = (string) $order->get_created_via();
    }

    if ($created_via === 'admin') {
        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

/**
 * Retourne la source métier de la commande.
 */
function doshift_get_order_source($order) {
    if (!$order) return 'site';

    $candidate_metas = [
        'woo_source',
        '_woo_source',
        'order_source',
        '_order_source',
        'source',
        '_source',
        'utm_source',
        '_utm_source',
        '_wc_order_attribution_utm_source',
        '_wc_order_attribution_source_type',
        '_wc_order_attribution_session_entry',
    ];

    $raw_source = '';

    foreach ($candidate_metas as $meta_key) {
        $value = (string) $order->get_meta($meta_key, true);
        if ($value !== '') {
            $raw_source = strtolower(trim($value));
            break;
        }
    }

    if ($raw_source !== '') {
        if (strpos($raw_source, 'meta') !== false || strpos($raw_source, 'facebook') !== false || strpos($raw_source, 'instagram') !== false) {
            return 'meta';
        }

        if (strpos($raw_source, 'google') !== false || strpos($raw_source, 'gads') !== false || strpos($raw_source, 'adwords') !== false) {
            return 'google';
        }

        if (strpos($raw_source, 'tiktok') !== false) {
            return 'tiktok';
        }

        if (strpos($raw_source, 'console') !== false || strpos($raw_source, 'admin') !== false) {
            return 'console';
        }

        if (strpos($raw_source, 'site') !== false || strpos($raw_source, 'checkout') !== false || strpos($raw_source, 'direct') !== false) {
            return 'site';
        }

        return sanitize_text_field($raw_source);
    }

    if (doshift_order_is_manual_admin_order($order)) {
        return 'console';
    }

    return 'site';
}

/**
 * Retourne le login utilisateur à envoyer dans l’API.
 */
function doshift_get_order_creator_user($order, $woo_source = '') {
    if (!$order) return 'unknown';

    if ($woo_source === '') {
        $woo_source = doshift_get_order_source($order);
    }

    if ($woo_source === 'console') {
        $post_author_id = 0;

        if (method_exists($order, 'get_id')) {
            $post_obj = get_post($order->get_id());
            if ($post_obj && !empty($post_obj->post_author)) {
                $post_author_id = (int) $post_obj->post_author;
            }
        }

        if ($post_author_id > 0) {
            $user = get_user_by('id', $post_author_id);
            if ($user) {
                return $user->user_login;
            }
        }

        $admin_creator_meta_keys = [
            '_created_by',
            'created_by',
            '_admin_user',
            'admin_user',
            '_order_created_by_user',
        ];

        foreach ($admin_creator_meta_keys as $meta_key) {
            $meta_val = (string) $order->get_meta($meta_key, true);
            if ($meta_val !== '') {
                return sanitize_text_field($meta_val);
            }
        }

        return 'admin';
    }

    $customer_id = (int) $order->get_user_id();
    if ($customer_id > 0) {
        $user = get_user_by('id', $customer_id);
        if ($user) {
            return $user->user_login;
        }
    }

    return 'guest';
}

/**
 * Retourne le nom affiché / nom complet de l’utilisateur à envoyer dans l’API.
 */
function doshift_get_order_creator_name($order, $woo_source = '') {
    if (!$order) return 'Unknown';

    if ($woo_source === '') {
        $woo_source = doshift_get_order_source($order);
    }

    if ($woo_source === 'console') {
        $post_author_id = 0;

        if (method_exists($order, 'get_id')) {
            $post_obj = get_post($order->get_id());
            if ($post_obj && !empty($post_obj->post_author)) {
                $post_author_id = (int) $post_obj->post_author;
            }
        }

        if ($post_author_id > 0) {
            $user = get_user_by('id', $post_author_id);
            if ($user) {
                if (!empty($user->display_name)) return $user->display_name;

                $full_name = trim(($user->first_name ?? '') . ' ' . ($user->last_name ?? ''));
                if ($full_name !== '') return $full_name;

                return $user->user_login;
            }
        }

        return 'Admin';
    }

    $customer_id = (int) $order->get_user_id();
    if ($customer_id > 0) {
        $user = get_user_by('id', $customer_id);
        if ($user) {
            if (!empty($user->display_name)) return $user->display_name;

            $full_name = trim(($user->first_name ?? '') . ' ' . ($user->last_name ?? ''));
            if ($full_name !== '') return $full_name;

            return $user->user_login;
        }
    }

    $billing_name = trim($order->get_billing_first_name() . ' ' . $order->get_billing_last_name());
    if ($billing_name !== '') {
        return $billing_name;
    }

    return 'Guest';
}

/* =========================================================
 * Envoi de la commande vers l’API
 * ======================================================= */

function doshift_orders_api_send($order_id, $force = false, $next_status_override = null, $status_override = null) {
    $order = wc_get_order($order_id);
    if (!$order) {
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Commande introuvable.'];
    }

    $settings = doshift_orders_api_get_settings();

    $already_sent = get_post_meta($order_id, '_doshift_api_sent', true);
    if ($already_sent && !$force) {
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Commande déjà envoyée (meta _doshift_api_sent présente).'];
    }

    // ========= CLIENT & ADRESSE =========
    $customer_name   = $order->get_billing_first_name();
    $customer_email  = $order->get_billing_email();
    $customer_phone  = $order->get_billing_phone();
    $billing_addr    = $order->get_billing_address_1();
    $billing_city_wc = $order->get_billing_city();
    $date_created    = $order->get_date_created() ? $order->get_date_created()->date('c') : '';

    // ========= SOURCE + USER =========
    $woo_source    = doshift_get_order_source($order);
    $woo_user      = doshift_get_order_creator_user($order, $woo_source);
    $woo_user_name = doshift_get_order_creator_name($order, $woo_source);

    // ========= VILLES =========
    $billing_city_code = $settings['billing_city_code_meta'] ? get_post_meta($order_id, $settings['billing_city_code_meta'], true) : '';
    $city_name_fr      = get_post_meta($order_id, 'city_name_fr', true);
    $city_name_ar      = get_post_meta($order_id, 'city_name_ar', true);

    $ozon_city_id       = $settings['ozon_city_id_meta']       ? get_post_meta($order_id, $settings['ozon_city_id_meta'], true)       : '';
    $ozon_city_name     = $settings['ozon_city_name_meta']     ? get_post_meta($order_id, $settings['ozon_city_name_meta'], true)     : '';
    $cathedis_city_id   = $settings['cathedis_city_id_meta']   ? get_post_meta($order_id, $settings['cathedis_city_id_meta'], true)   : '';
    $cathedis_city_name = $settings['cathedis_city_name_meta'] ? get_post_meta($order_id, $settings['cathedis_city_name_meta'], true) : '';

    $city_shipping_price = get_post_meta($order_id, 'price_delivered', true);
    $billing_city_display = $city_name_fr ?: $billing_city_wc;

    // ========= ITEMS (+ supplier_code) =========
    $items_array = [];
    foreach ($order->get_items() as $item) {
        if (!is_a($item, 'WC_Order_Item_Product')) continue;

        $product    = $item->get_product();
        $sku        = $product ? $product->get_sku() : '';
        $image_url  = $product ? wp_get_attachment_url($product->get_image_id()) : '';
        $product_id = $product ? $product->get_id() : 0;

        $supplier_code = doshift_get_supplier_code_from_order_item($item);

        $items_array[] = [
            "woo_id"              => (int) $product_id,
            "product_sku"         => $sku,
            "product_name"        => $item->get_name(),
            "supplier_code"       => ($supplier_code !== '' ? $supplier_code : null),
            "quantity"            => (int) $item->get_quantity(),
            "price"               => (float) $order->get_item_subtotal($item, false),
            "total"               => (float) $item->get_total(),
            "product_description" => $product ? wp_strip_all_tags($product->get_description()) : '',
            "product_image_url"   => $image_url,
        ];
    }

    $status_to_send = ($status_override !== null && $status_override !== '') ? $status_override : $settings['status_to_send'];

    // ========= PAYLOAD =========
    $payload = [
        "woo_order_id"           => (string) $order_id,
        "status"                 => $status_to_send,
        "total"                  => (float) $order->get_total(),

        "woo_user"               => $woo_user,
        "woo_user_name"          => $woo_user_name,
        "woo_source"             => $woo_source,

        "customer_email"         => $customer_email,
        "customer_phone"         => $customer_phone,
        "customer_name"          => $customer_name,
        "billing_address"        => $billing_addr,

        "billing_city"           => $billing_city_display,
        "billing_city_code"      => $billing_city_code,
        "billing_city_name_fr"   => $city_name_fr,
        "billing_city_name_ar"   => $city_name_ar,

        "ozon_city_id"           => ($ozon_city_id !== '' ? (int) $ozon_city_id : null),
        "ozon_city_name"         => ($ozon_city_name ?: $city_name_fr),

        "cathedis_city_id"       => ($cathedis_city_id !== '' ? (int) $cathedis_city_id : null),
        "cathedis_city_name"     => ($cathedis_city_name ?: $city_name_fr),

        "shipping_amount_city"   => ($city_shipping_price !== '' ? (float) $city_shipping_price : null),
        "date_created"           => $date_created,

        "items" => [
            "create" => $items_array,
        ],
    ];

    update_post_meta($order_id, '_doshift_detected_woo_source', $woo_source);
    update_post_meta($order_id, '_doshift_detected_woo_user', $woo_user);
    update_post_meta($order_id, '_doshift_detected_woo_user_name', $woo_user_name);

    $request_body = wp_json_encode($payload);
	error_log('DOSHIFT PAYLOAD SIZE = ' . strlen($request_body));

    $response = wp_remote_post($settings['api_url'], [
        'method'  => 'POST',
        'timeout' => 20,
        'headers' => [
            'Authorization' => 'Bearer ' . $settings['api_token'],
            'Content-Type'  => 'application/json',
        ],
        'body' => $request_body,
    ]);

    update_post_meta($order_id, '_doshift_api_last_payload', $request_body);

    if (is_wp_error($response)) {
        $msg = 'Erreur HTTP : ' . $response->get_error_message();
        update_post_meta($order_id, '_doshift_api_last_response', $msg);
        $order->add_order_note('DoShift API : échec envoi → ' . $msg);
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => $msg];
    }

    $code = (int) wp_remote_retrieve_response_code($response);
    $body = (string) wp_remote_retrieve_body($response);

    update_post_meta($order_id, '_doshift_api_last_http_code', $code);
    update_post_meta($order_id, '_doshift_api_last_response', $body);

    if ($code >= 200 && $code < 300) {
        update_post_meta($order_id, '_doshift_api_sent', current_time('mysql'));
        $order->add_order_note('DoShift API : envoi réussi (HTTP ' . $code . ').');

        $next_status = ($next_status_override !== null && $next_status_override !== '')
            ? $next_status_override
            : (!empty($settings['success_next_status']) ? $settings['success_next_status'] : '');

        if ($next_status && $order->get_status() !== $next_status) {
            $order->update_status($next_status, 'DoShift API : statut changé après envoi réussi.');
        }

        return [
            'success'       => true,
            'message'       => 'Envoi réussi (HTTP ' . $code . ').',
            'http_code'     => $code,
            'response_body' => $body,
        ];
    }

    $msg = 'Réponse API invalide (HTTP ' . $code . ').';
    $order->add_order_note('DoShift API : échec envoi → ' . $msg);

    return [
        'success'       => false,
        'message'       => $msg,
        'http_code'     => $code,
        'response_body' => $body,
    ];
}

/* =========================================================
 * Auto-envoi lors du changement de statut
 * ======================================================= */

add_action('woocommerce_order_status_changed', function ($order_id, $old_status, $new_status, $order) {
    $settings = doshift_orders_api_get_settings();
    $auto_status1 = !empty($settings['auto_send_status'])   ? $settings['auto_send_status']   : '';
    $auto_status2 = !empty($settings['auto_send_status_2']) ? $settings['auto_send_status_2'] : '';

    if ($auto_status1 && $new_status === $auto_status1) {
        $next1   = !empty($settings['success_next_status']) ? $settings['success_next_status'] : null;
        $status1 = !empty($settings['status_to_send'])      ? $settings['status_to_send']      : 'ENCOURS';
        doshift_orders_api_send($order_id, true, $next1, $status1);

    } elseif ($auto_status2 && $new_status === $auto_status2) {
        $next2   = !empty($settings['success_next_status_2']) ? $settings['success_next_status_2'] : null;
        $status2 = !empty($settings['status_to_send_2'])      ? $settings['status_to_send_2']      : $settings['status_to_send'];
        doshift_orders_api_send($order_id, false, $next2, $status2);
    }
}, 10, 4);

/* =========================================================
 * Metabox admin : bouton "DoShift : Renvoyer vers API"
 * ======================================================= */

add_action('add_meta_boxes', function () {
    add_meta_box(
        'doshift_orders_api_box',
        'DoShift : API Commande',
        'doshift_orders_api_metabox',
        'shop_order',
        'side',
        'high'
    );
});

function doshift_orders_api_metabox($post) {
    $order_id       = $post->ID;
    $sent           = get_post_meta($order_id, '_doshift_api_sent', true);
    $last_http      = get_post_meta($order_id, '_doshift_api_last_http_code', true);
    $woo_source     = get_post_meta($order_id, '_doshift_detected_woo_source', true);
    $woo_user       = get_post_meta($order_id, '_doshift_detected_woo_user', true);
    $woo_user_name  = get_post_meta($order_id, '_doshift_detected_woo_user_name', true);

    $nonce = wp_create_nonce('doshift_orders_api_send_order');

    if ($sent) {
        echo '<p><strong>Déjà envoyé :</strong><br><code>' . esc_html($sent) . '</code></p>';
        if ($last_http) {
            echo '<p>Dernier HTTP code : <code>' . esc_html($last_http) . '</code></p>';
        }
    } else {
        echo '<p>Cette commande n’a pas encore été envoyée à l’API.</p>';
    }

    if ($woo_source !== '') {
        echo '<p><strong>woo_source :</strong> <code>' . esc_html($woo_source) . '</code></p>';
    }

    if ($woo_user !== '') {
        echo '<p><strong>woo_user :</strong> <code>' . esc_html($woo_user) . '</code></p>';
    }

    if ($woo_user_name !== '') {
        echo '<p><strong>woo_user_name :</strong> <code>' . esc_html($woo_user_name) . '</code></p>';
    }

    echo '<p><button type="button" class="button button-primary" id="doshift-send-to-api"
            data-order-id="' . esc_attr($order_id) . '"
            data-nonce="' . esc_attr($nonce) . '"
            data-force="1">DoShift : Renvoyer vers API</button></p>';
    ?>
    <script>
    jQuery(function($){
        $('#doshift-send-to-api').on('click', function(e){
            e.preventDefault();
            var $btn = $(this);

            $btn.prop('disabled', true).text('Envoi en cours...');

            $.post(ajaxurl, {
                action:   'doshift_orders_api_send_order',
                order_id: $btn.data('order-id'),
                _wpnonce: $btn.data('nonce'),
                force:    $btn.data('force') ? 1 : 0
            }, function(resp){
                if (resp && resp.success) {
                    alert('Envoi réussi');
                    window.location.reload();
                } else {
                    alert('Envoi échoué : ' + (resp && resp.data && resp.data.message ? resp.data.message : 'Erreur inconnue'));
                    $btn.prop('disabled', false).text('DoShift : Renvoyer vers API');
                }
            }).fail(function(){
                alert('Erreur AJAX.');
                $btn.prop('disabled', false).text('DoShift : Renvoyer vers API');
            });
        });
    });
    </script>
    <?php
}

add_action('wp_ajax_doshift_orders_api_send_order', function () {
    if (!current_user_can('edit_shop_orders')) {
        wp_send_json_error(['message' => 'Permission refusée.']);
    }

    check_ajax_referer('doshift_orders_api_send_order');

    $order_id = isset($_POST['order_id']) ? (int) $_POST['order_id'] : 0;
    $force    = !empty($_POST['force']);

    if (!$order_id) {
        wp_send_json_error(['message' => 'ID commande manquant.']);
    }

    $settings = doshift_orders_api_get_settings();
    $status1  = !empty($settings['status_to_send']) ? $settings['status_to_send'] : 'ENCOURS';

    $result = doshift_orders_api_send($order_id, $force, null, $status1);

    if (!empty($result['success'])) {
        wp_send_json_success(['message' => $result['message']]);
    } else {
        wp_send_json_error(['message' => $result['message']]);
    }
});
